objective: Preallocate SHOW and DESCRIBE schema lookup keys from table-name length.

tasks.title: Preallocate SHOW schema keys
tasks.result: DESCRIBE and SHOW CREATE TABLE schema lookups now use an explicit-capacity helper instead of format! for schema:<table> keys.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The helper reserves capacity for schema:<table> before pushing known components.
The optimization replaces format! in DESCRIBE TABLE and SHOW CREATE TABLE schema lookup key construction.
Generated schema key bytes, DESCRIBE output, SHOW CREATE TABLE output, and broader DDL behavior are unchanged.
git diff --check printed the existing CRLF normalization warning for src/execution/ddl/show.rs while exiting successfully.
